stable.notes: Fix release for 0.5.266. Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. Jump to your session works again: COS Control can bring your Claude, Cursor or Terminal session to the front (macOS asks once per app), and Guided Setup's Terminal step works. Speaker ID works with the bundled Node runtime. If a session jump stops after an update, use Reset and add again in Settings > Session pet. Pairs with server 6.65.0.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
